about: compiler/syntax: the scanner (S2a, SL5) and the tree and parser (S2b, SL6). TestScanAgreesWithGo and TestParseAgreesWithGo (internal/sketch/syntax, in process through internal/linked/syntax) kill a row that names them; a gap names the law that kills the rest. Paths are from the repository root.

mutants.name: scan-semi-after-rparen
mutants.rule: A newline after `)` inserts a semicolon (Go's rule).
mutants.gap: killed by law SemiMasksAreTheRule (ergo test compiler/syntax), not by the agreement tests; no Go suite runs compiler/'s laws until scripts/mutants has a compiler scope (GT7, batch 22)

mutants.name: scan-end-stops-at-escaped-quote
mutants.rule: End steps over an escaped byte of a string: an escaped quote does not end it.

mutants.name: scan-raw-end-off-by-one
mutants.rule: A raw string ends after its closing backquote.

mutants.name: scan-keyword-prefix
mutants.rule: A word is a keyword only when all of it is: `fortune` is an identifier.
mutants.gap: killed by law KeywordTableIsTheRule (ergo test compiler/syntax), not by the agreement tests; no Go suite runs compiler/'s laws until scripts/mutants has a compiler scope (GT7, batch 22)

mutants.name: scan-two-byte-operator-split
mutants.from: return if c1 == '=' { Eql } else { Assign }
mutants.rule: `==` is one token, not two `=`.

mutants.name: scan-rune-octal-bound
mutants.rule: An octal rune escape names a byte: '\400' is not a rune literal (Go's strconv.Unquote, which oneRune reads without allocating).

mutants.name: scan-class-zero-a-letter
mutants.rule: A digit is not a letter: `0` cannot start an identifier.

mutants.name: scan-semi-mask-drops-ident
mutants.rule: A newline after an identifier inserts a semicolon.

mutants.name: scan-kwtable-swaps-two
mutants.rule: Each keyword hashes to its own kind.

mutants.name: scan-punct-comma-as-period
mutants.rule: A comma is Comma.

mutants.name: scan-path-ascii-digit-starts-element
mutants.rule: An import path element starts with a letter or `_`, not a digit.

mutants.name: scan-opfast-ignores-doubled
mutants.rule: A doubled operator byte (`<<`, `&&`, `..`) is a longer token: run's arm leaves it to opKind.

mutants.name: comments-blank-line-joins-groups
mutants.rule: A blank line between two comments ends the first one's group (go/parser).

mutants.name: failure-position-from-file-start
mutants.rule: A failure reports the line and column of its own offset.

mutants.name: tree-children-flushed-in-reverse
mutants.rule: A record keeps its children in source order.

mutants.name: tree-stack-not-cut-after-list
mutants.rule: rec cuts the stack back to the list's mark.

mutants.name: tree-rewind-keeps-extra
mutants.rule: A rewind cuts extra back to its checkpoint.
mutants.gap: killed by law ExtraTiles (ergo test compiler/syntax), not by the agreement tests; no Go suite runs compiler/'s laws until scripts/mutants has a compiler scope (GT7, batch 22)

mutants.name: view-reads-b-for-a
mutants.from: BinaryExpr{X: nid(t, a), Op: int(tok), Y: nid(t, b)}
mutants.to: BinaryExpr{X: nid(t, b), Op: int(tok), Y: nid(t, a)}
mutants.rule: View reads each operand from its own word.

mutants.name: view-none-as-row-0
mutants.rule: An optional child's 0 word is none, never row 0.

mutants.name: tree-row-gains-string
mutants.rule: A row holds no pointer (PointerFree).
mutants.gap: PointerFree needs the layout std (LAY1), not on this base: the mutant does not even compile until NewTree sets names, and no law sees a pointer field. It survives until LAY1 lands.

mutants.name: skip-without-literal
mutants.to: n == String || n == StringHead || n == LParen
mutants.rule: skip is a statement only before a string literal: skip(x) stays a call (contextual, no scanner keyword).

mutants.name: skip-end-at-keyword
mutants.from:
if kd == KSkipStmt {
		return tokEnd(k, int(a))
mutants.to:
if kd == KSkipStmt {
		return tokEnd(k, tok)
mutants.rule: A skip statement ends where its reason ends.

mutants.name: skip-interpolation-accepted
mutants.from:
if p.tk == StringHead {
		errorAt(p, pos(p), tokLen(p), "skip takes
mutants.to:
if false {
		errorAt(p, pos(p), tokLen(p), "skip takes
mutants.rule: A skip's reason is a literal with no interpolation: an interpolated one is S001 at the literal.

mutants.name: columns-token-end-short
mutants.rule: A token's column carries its end, the second scan's (End): a name's or a literal's text is its whole span.

mutants.name: columns-group-last-is-first
mutants.rule: A comment group carries its last comment: a doc of several lines is every line.

mutants.name: columns-failure-unflagged
mutants.from: out = out.Append(if p.Failed { uint32(1) } else { uint32(0) })
mutants.rule: A failed parse says so in the header, so a host reports the failure, never an empty tree.
